assets.design-target-v5.png: Use case: ui-mockup. Reference 2 is OUR ACCEPTED ORIGINAL CHARACTER: use the jade-and-ivory swordsman exactly; do not redesign his face or costume. This is a professional paid-game menu, NOT a website, NOT a dashboard, NOT a room with floating widgets, NOT a promotional poster. No generic rounded cards, no empty giant fields, no modern green SaaS panels. Main layout: left 27% is detailed martial stats with red HP and jade XP bars, four diamond-shaped small stat/trait emblems, compact skill/economy information; middle 37% is a beautiful large waist-up portrait of our character on pale desaturated ink-gray paper, equipped sword/armor/jade square icons in a grounded tray below portrait, character name upper left and power badge; right 30% is actual modest weapon collection: exactly three large item slots for sword, dao, hand-wraps, show sword owned and other two dim/unowned, then a compact daily progress region of three diamond nodes and next practice cost. Include actual character name "梦之咩咩团子", class "剑客", level "四级", power "228", HP "274 / 274", ATK "59", DEF "19", SPD "27", silver "286". Make the design coherent, expertly balanced and crisp, rich restrained details but readable. Mostly warm gray/charcoal/ivory with brass linework and tiny red/jade accents. No outside brand logo or characters from reference 1, no English, no game title from reference 1. It should look as convincingly crafted as the supplied real game screenshot.

Reference screenshot is only a visual design reference for the engraved panel edging; DO NOT copy or include any game characters, text, icons, screenshots or filled menu content. Draw a refined rectangular frame precisely aligned to x5%-95%,y5%-95%. Perimeter consists of irregular charcoal ink outer edge, fine twin desaturated brass/antique gold inset strokes, four elegant recessed curved corner motifs with tiny geometric Chinese knot engravings. Frame material is subtle worn inked paper and etched brass, matte, NOT shiny metallic 3D, no wood beams, no neon or glow. Central 76% is completely empty TRANSPARENT and has no fill, no painting, no texture, no white/black backdrop. Clean isolated production 9-slice border for a classic paid indie wuxia RPG menu. Exactly one frame only, no atlas, no text, no letters, no seals, no labels, no numbers. Transparent background must be real alpha, not a drawn checkerboard.

Transparent alpha outside glyphs, no colored glow, no backgrounds, no gradients. NO text, NO letters, NO Chinese characters, NO digits, NO UI diamonds or borders, no weapon inventory items. All glyphs consistent stroke and weight.
